thread:
evan_wu: Heads-up— CascadePay POC kickoff. They want a true drop-in for vendorX:/v1/respond with minimal client changes. Key success metrics: prompt parity, deterministic diffs for QA, predictable billing during cutover. 10 business days. Need SE + Security + Finance weigh-in.

sarah_kline: Do we have their sample corpus? chat arrays vs single prompt matters for token counts. Also what's their p95 target?

evan_wu: Corpus link in drive (about 800 samples). Mostly message arrays. They asked for 300ms p95 ideally, will accept 700ms during heavy windows.

omar_ibrahim: Quick POC plan suggestion:
1) compat shim that accepts VendorX envelope and translates to redwood-chat API.
2) deterministic harness (temp=0, top_p=1, fixed RNG if available).
3) response-normalizer: strip vendor debug fields, canonicalize dates/currency, normalize whitespace.
4) run 1k A/B pairs, produce token delta + semantic-similarity report.

omar_ibrahim: Example shim snippet to share with their devs:
```
# incoming VendorX
POST /v1/respond
{ "prompt": "List charges for acct 42", "max_tokens": 200 }
# shim -> Redwood
POST /v1/chat.complete
{ "model": "redwood-chat-1", "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"List charges for acct 42"}], "max_tokens": 200, "temperature": 0 }
```
This keeps the client call shape almost identical.

sarah_kline: Pricing: they want a temporary flat per-call migration price for 14 days to avoid surprises. Finance asked for three representative token counts (low/med/high) + estimated monthly cost at current QPS. I'll pull counts from the drive samples.

nina_gomez: Security checklist items: EU data residency requirement flagged; BYOK via Azure KV requested; 12mo audit log retention; DPA signed; per-request correlation id forwarded to their SIEM. Need staging allowlist.

evan_wu: They want a smoke on Tue morning UTC (06:00-08:00). Can we commit?

omar_ibrahim: Tue morning smoke OK. I'll spin up shim and wiring tonight. Will run deterministic harness and post results.

deploy-bot: staging env "cascadepay-poc" created in eu-west-1. Firewall rule template created; awaiting allowlist IPs.

sarah_kline: For the flat price propose $0.02 per call for up to 200k calls during 14-day cutover, then revert to token billing. I'll draft and circulate with finance.

nina_gomez: Operational blocker: if they insist Azure KV CMK in EU-only, we may need Dedicated/Private. Flagging to infra/legal.

evan_wu: Action items: 1) omar - PR for shim + harness; 2) sarah - flat-rate draft + token compare; 3) nina - security Qs + docs; 4) infra - finalize allowlist. Meeting invite to CascadePay for Tue 06:15 UTC. Marking thread active.

sarah_kline: :thumbsup: will share a short example costing table (3 samples) by EOD today.

omar_ibrahim: Will post A/B diff report (semantic sim + top-3 failure cases) after harness run.

nina_gomez: I'll attach SOC2 + ISO certs and start the DPA thread with legal.

evan_wu: Nice work. Any other enterprise blockers?

nina_gomez: KMS agreement + EU key residency + signed DPA remain the main blockers. Otherwise good to proceed.
